name: mc_snapshot
title: Snapshot region
description:
Captures the current block contents of a region so it can be restored later with mc_restore, or lists every snapshot currently stored on the server. Also lists and deletes build journal entries (every writing mc_build, mc_repair and mc_restore keeps one). This is the manual counterpart to mc_build's own `snapshot: true` option - use it to protect an area before an experimental or risky change, independent of any single build call.

WHEN TO USE: before manually editing an area across several separate mc_build calls when you want one restore point covering all of them (mc_build's own snapshot option only covers that single call's bounding box); before letting a user try something destructive; to check what snapshots already exist and their ids/labels/timestamps before deciding whether to restore one, or before running low on the server's snapshot slots (oldest snapshots are evicted automatically once the configured maximum is reached).

WHEN NOT TO USE: to read current block contents (use mc_inspect - snapshots do not display their contents, they only exist to be restored later). If you already passed `snapshot: true` to mc_build for a single build call, calling mc_snapshot again for the same region is redundant.

PARAMETERS: `action` is "create" (default), "list", "journal-list" or "journal-delete". "journal-list" returns journal entries newest first (id, time, tool, world, bounds, changed cells, label, undo links); filters: `since` (ISO-8601 UTC instant), `label` (substring), `world`, `touches` {from,to} (exactly the entries that changed a cell in that box - answers "which builds touched this area?") and `limit` (default 50). "journal-delete" removes entry `id`. For "create": `world` (optional, defaults to the plugin's default world), `from`/`to` (required, inclusive [x, y, z] corners in any order, X east/Z south/Y up, volume up to 200,000 blocks), and an optional `label` string to help identify the snapshot later. "list" takes no other parameters and returns every stored snapshot regardless of world.

SIDE EFFECTS: "create" does not modify the world - it only reads and stores a copy of the region, comparable in cost to mc_inspect over the same volume. It does consume one of the server's limited snapshot slots; the oldest snapshot is silently evicted once the configured maximum count is reached, so do not rely on a snapshot existing indefinitely. "list" and "journal-list" have no side effects at all; "journal-delete" permanently removes that undo record (not the blocks).

action.description: "create" (default) takes a new snapshot; "list" returns every snapshot currently stored; "journal-list" lists build journal entries; "journal-delete" removes one.

world.description: World name for a create (omitted uses the plugin's configured default world), or a journal-list filter.

from.description: Inclusive [x, y, z] corner of the region to capture. Required when action is create.

to.description: Inclusive [x, y, z] corner opposite `from`. Required when action is create.

label.description: Optional free-text note stored with a new snapshot, e.g. "before tower"; for journal-list, a case-insensitive substring filter.

id.description: journal-delete: the journal id to remove.

since.description: journal-list: only entries created at or after this ISO-8601 UTC instant, e.g. "2026-10-10T12:00:00Z".

touches.description: journal-list: only entries that changed at least one cell inside this inclusive box.
